scientific_integrity: Explicit exact finite derivation from the weighted matrix-tree theorem with independent exact-rational checks; not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Requires a one-vertex intersection of two subsets of a uniformly sampled Cayley tree. The sharp asymptotic assumes positive limiting size fractions summing to at most one; general transfer-current techniques pre-exist this special formula. Historical priority remains to be independently checked.
title: Sharp rank-one dependence for overlapping induced forests in uniform Cayley trees
